stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
stories.simple_summary: China has been using Nvidia computer chips that the U.S. government said they couldn't buy. These chips are very powerful and help train advanced AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about government policy and international business. For ordinary people and small businesses, there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT is getting a new feature called Wallet that lets the AI do online shopping for you, including paying for items. It's starting with some paid subscribers in the U.S.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT Pro and trust AI with your money, this could save you time on shopping. Most small business owners won't be affected unless they sell products online.

stories.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
stories.simple_summary: Jensen Huang, the leader of Nvidia, has stepped down from his job. This happened because of a personal matter involving someone else's partner, and people worry it could affect America's competition with China on advanced technology.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you work in tech or invest in Nvidia stock, this doesn't directly affect your daily life. It's mostly important to investors and people in the computer industry.

stories.title: Not Nvidia. Not Micron. This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Will Be 2027’s Biggest Winner After the Latest Tech Sell-Off
stories.simple_summary: This article claims a different AI company's stock will do better than Nvidia's in 2027. The headline doesn't say which company.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment advice for stock market players. Regular small business owners don't need to worry about this.

stories.title: What’s really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga
stories.simple_summary: The Verge is saying Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia is part of a bigger story about Nvidia doing business with China and what the U.S. government will allow.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly for investors and people interested in how government rules affect big tech companies. There's nothing you personally need to do.

stories.title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
stories.simple_summary: A company called ElevenLabs made a new app that listens to meetings, writes down what people said, and takes notes automatically. It's designed for teams working together.
stories.why_it_matters: If your small business has lots of meetings and you want automatic notes instead of writing them by hand, this could save time. Otherwise, you probably won't use it.

stories.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic made an AI helper called Claude Duet that tries to do tasks for regular people, not just computer programmers. The person testing it found it surprisingly useful.
stories.why_it_matters: This is in the early stages of testing. If you're curious about AI helpers, you could try it, but most small business owners won't change how they work because of this.

stories.title: Israel’s VCs see opportunity for challengers in Nvidia’s turmoil
stories.simple_summary: Because Nvidia is having troubles, companies starting new businesses in Israel think they have a chance to sell computer chips as an alternative to Nvidia.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers. Small business owners don't need to think about this.

stories.title: Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says
stories.simple_summary: During a meeting last summer, Jensen Huang said his replacement seemed nervous and unprepared. This suggests he didn't think his replacement was ready for the job.
stories.why_it_matters: This is business gossip that matters mainly to investors and Nvidia employees. It won't affect you.

stories.title: Let’s talk about Jensen Huang’s many affairs!
stories.simple_summary: This article is making jokes about the fact that multiple personal relationships have been mentioned in stories about Jensen Huang's departure, making the situation confusing and hard to follow.
stories.why_it_matters: This is entertainment news, not something that changes how AI works or affects your business.

stories.title: Mass smuggling of up to 1.5 million Nvidia AI GPUs could be the underlying cause of Jensen Huang's departure, leading analysts claim — more than 1.5 gigawatts of banned chips tracked to China despite export controls
stories.simple_summary: Large amounts of Nvidia computer chips meant to be banned from going to China may have been illegally shipped there anyway, and some people think this scandal might be why Jensen Huang left his job.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about government rules and international trade. Small business owners don't need to do anything about this.

stories.title: Could AI help decide medals at LA28 Olympics?
stories.simple_summary: People are asking whether AI could help judges decide which athletes get medals at the Los Angeles Olympics in 2028.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just an interesting question for sports fans. It has nothing to do with your daily life or business.
